name: polynesian
description: Ten Polynesian daughters against Walworth's Proto-Polynesian, over the concepts where every daughter shares a cognate set with the gold entry. Clean regularity and an uncontroversial subgrouping, which is what makes it a development benchmark rather than a hard one.

targets.source_reference: Walworth Polynesian CLDF: Proto-Polynesian reconstructions held out as evaluation target

provenance.leakage_note: The gold is a published reconstruction and the Polynesian sound correspondences are extensively described, so a model that has read the literature can produce *ʔ from memory rather than from the correspondence set. Trajectories record every polarize call and the directionality_rationale of every contrast-reducing rule, which supports a check on whether the evidence was consulted; it is not proof, and no headline claim should rest on this benchmark. Use benchmarks/synthetic/ for a leakage-free measurement.
provenance.note: Nuclear Polynesian is left as a three-way polytomy because Samoic is paraphyletic; the harness supports unresolved nodes natively.
